verdict.rationale: Forter offers AI agents, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The pack only documents Forter's own MCP server, which external AI clients such as Claude Desktop connect to. That is the server role, a different story, and nothing shows Forter or its agents connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
